answer: Before first payout, the holder links a fishing vessel licence, its number and one signed catch log from the ocean. Two verifiers match both against the fisheries register in a week; a catch claimed twice, or no vessel on record, closes both. A licence costs 3,000,000 rupiah a year, so one fisher pays once while a thousand fakes need a thousand licences and 3 billion. The walnut-handled gaff hauls the catch from glacier-cold water.
